packets.title: Require canonical roadmap authority in context receipts
packets.objective:
Execution class: free-exec. One outcome only: make the context receipt reject an authority map that omits the canonical roadmap.

In gateway/context_receipt.py, inside _load_authorities, replace this exact text:

        "decisions",
        "live_status",

with this exact text:

        "decisions",
        "roadmap",
        "live_status",

In tests/test_context_receipt.py, make exactly these four additions:

1. In _authority_map(), immediately after:
        ("decisions", "docs/DECISIONS.md"),
   add:
        ("roadmap", "docs/ROADMAP.md"),

2. In _start_here(), immediately after:
        "docs/DECISIONS.md",
   add:
        "docs/ROADMAP.md",

3. In _repo(), immediately after:
    _write(repo / "docs/DECISIONS.md", "# Decisions\n")
   add:
    _write(repo / "docs/ROADMAP.md", "# Roadmap\n")

4. Append this test verbatim:

def test_receipt_requires_roadmap_authority(tmp_path: Path):
    repo, _ = _repo(tmp_path)
    path = repo / "docs/AUTHORITY_MAP.md"
    lines = [
        line
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        if "`roadmap`" not in line
    ]
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    levels = _levels(repo)

    assert levels["docs:authority_map"] == "FAIL"

Change nothing else. Stopping rule: if any quoted anchor is absent or occurs more than once, make no changes and fail the attempt. Do not search for similar text.
acceptance_criteria: The context receipt returns a FAIL-level docs:authority_map check when the authority map omits the roadmap concern.
The context-receipt test fixture includes docs/ROADMAP.md in both the authority map and canonical reading order.
The static gate fails on the unmodified tree and passes only after both the runtime requirement and regression test exist.
The targeted pytest and Ruff commands exit 0.

packets.title: Replace stale KX-06 checkpoint with the daylight proof action
packets.objective:
Execution class: free-exec. One outcome only: replace the stale KX-06 checkpoint pair with a machine-readable KTF-001 daylight-proof checkpoint.

Run exactly the following command from the repository root. Do not edit any other file.

python3.12 - <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

OLD_NEXT = 'Start the two queued KX-06 packets: KX-06-01 (signals feed on Home, priority 8) then KX-06-02 (plain-English deadline/phone/what-changed cards). The Builder Run button works now, so they can be started from the UI or with ./kitty builder initiative run kx-06-proactive-feed-v1 --free --gate manual.'
NEW_NEXT = 'Run the KTF-001 daylight unattended Builder pass on the canonical machine, inspect task/attempt/lease/validation/PR evidence, and verify unrelated work continues after failure while provider exhaustion pauses durably.'
PATHS = (
    (Path(".claude/STATE.md"), "kitty-state", "in_progress"),
    (Path(".claude/HANDOFF.md"), "kitty-handoff", "valid"),
)

def load_payload(path: Path, marker: str) -> dict:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    match = re.search(r"<!--\s*" + re.escape(marker) + r"\s*(\{.*?\})\s*-->", text, re.DOTALL)
    if match is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing {marker} metadata in {path}")
    payload = json.loads(match.group(1))
    if payload.get("next_action") != OLD_NEXT:
        raise SystemExit(f"stale next_action anchor not found exactly in {path}")
    return payload

for path, marker, _status in PATHS:
    load_payload(path, marker)

head = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    check=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
).stdout.strip()
branch = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"],
    check=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
).stdout.strip()
if branch == "HEAD":
    raise SystemExit("detached HEAD; refusing to write checkpoint")
updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

completed = [
    "PR #264 restored clean-checkout Python and frontend CI",
    "PR #261 retained KittyBuilder Brain research and hardened manifest validation",
    "PR #262 repaired 33 impossible initiative validation gates",
    "PR #263 consolidated the canonical roadmap, KTF-001 mission, packet standard, and Builder authority",
    "KTF-FE-01 made roadmap ownership a required context-receipt contract",
    "KTF-FE-02 replaced the stale KX-06 checkpoint pair with the daylight-proof next action",
]
invalidations = [
    "HEAD changes beyond the checkpoint-only commit that records this payload",
    "branch or worktree changes",
    "docs/ACTIVE_MISSION.md no longer records KTF-001 as running",
    "the KTF-001 daylight Builder pass starts or completes",
    "material Builder queue, attempt, lease, provider, or PR state changes",
]

for path, marker, status in PATHS:
    payload = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "updated_at": updated_at,
        "head_sha": head,
        "branch": branch,
        "worktree": ".",
        "status": status,
        "completed_items": completed,
        "blockers": [],
        "next_action": NEW_NEXT,
        "invalidation_conditions": invalidations,
        "active_mission": "docs/ACTIVE_MISSION.md",
        "pull_request": None,
    }
    metadata = json.dumps(payload, indent=2)
    if marker == "kitty-state":
        body = f"""# Session State — KTF-001 daylight proof ready

<!-- {marker}
{metadata}
-->

## Checkpoint

KTF-001 governance and the first two free-exec packets are resolved. The next
mutation is the daylight Builder proof on the canonical machine.

## Next step

{NEW_NEXT}
"""
    else:
        body = f"""# Handoff — KTF-001 daylight proof

<!-- {marker}
{metadata}
-->

## Outcome

CI, initiative review, validation-gate repair, and governance consolidation are
recorded in Git and GitHub. Builder runtime truth remains local and must be read
through supported projections.

## Next step

{NEW_NEXT}
"""
    path.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
PY

Stopping rule: if either metadata block is missing, either exact OLD_NEXT value differs, Git is detached, or the command exits non-zero, make no further changes and fail the attempt. Do not search for similar text or partially rewrite one file.
acceptance_criteria: Both checkpoint files contain valid schema-version-1 metadata for KTF-001 and the exact daylight Builder proof next action.
STATE is in_progress, HANDOFF is valid, both record the current packet branch and pre-commit HEAD, and their completed items, blockers, next action, and invalidation conditions agree.
Neither checkpoint file contains KX-06-01 or the superseded KX-06 next action.
The static gate fails on the unmodified tree and the context-receipt plus cold-start acceptance tests exit 0 after the replacement.
validation_commands: grep -q 'daylight unattended Builder pass on the canonical machine' .claude/STATE.md && grep -q 'daylight unattended Builder pass on the canonical machine' .claude/HANDOFF.md && ! grep -q 'KX-06-01' .claude/STATE.md && ! grep -q 'KX-06-01' .claude/HANDOFF.md
